그 자리 제한 속도의 60%를 넘으면 시야가 넓어지고, 2c부터 별이 짧: Above 60% of the speed limit of where you are the view widens, and from 2c the stars stretch into short streaks. Turn it off if it makes you dizzy.
효과음은 M 키 / 🔊 버튼, 배경 음악은 B 키 / ♪ 버튼으로 따로: Sound effects: the M key / the 🔊 button. Music: the B key / the ♪ button. Each is switched on and off by itself.
열한 곡(오르골, 새벽, 먼 바다, 자장가, 별무리, 깊은 밤, 유영,: Eleven tunes (Music Box, Dawn, Far Sea, Lullaby, Star Cluster, Deep Night, Drifting, Raindrops, Gayageum, Aurora, Carousel) play for about two minutes each. The order changes every time you open the game. Near a body the notes come often, far out they are low and few, and on a surface only the chords stay.
크기는 실제대로, 천체 사이의 빈 거리는 1/100(위성과 행성 사이는: Fly through a universe where sizes are real and the empty distances between bodies are squeezed to 1/100 (1/10 between a moon and its planet).
\"목표 고정\" 단추. 고른 곳을 화면 가운데에 붙잡아 둡니다. 옆걸음: The "Lock target" button. It keeps the chosen place in the middle of the screen. Circle it with the slide buttons, and go nearer or back off with forward and reverse. Dragging the screen lets go.
Press the small map at the left to open it. Pick a place on the map or by name. "Jump" puts you there six seconds later (even a place you have not been to). "Face it" only turns you that way and locks on.
R 키 / 굽은 화살표 버튼. 시야만 뒤로 돌립니다. 나는 방향과 속도는: The R key / the bent arrow button. Only the view turns back. Your heading and speed stay as they are, and pressing again looks forward.
방향키(↑ ↓ ← →) / 방향키 모양의 단추 넷 / A · D 키(왼쪽: Arrow keys (↑ ↓ ← →) / the four buttons shaped like arrow keys / the A and D keys (left, right). You slide up, down, left or right while looking the same way. Let go and you keep that speed; press stop to halt.
Q / E · roll left and right. You can also turn all the way round up and down.
W / 전진 버튼, S / 후진 버튼. 누르는 동안 현재 안전 속도까지: W / the forward button, S / the reverse button. While held you speed up to the safe speed of the place; let go and you keep flying at that speed. Press the other way and you stop for about a second, then go the other way. Near a body you slow down by yourself.
가까울수록 느리게, 멀수록 빠르게 (0.01c → 100c): Slower when near, faster when far (0.01c → 100c)
The slider at the bottom of a wide screen. On a phone it is always 100%.
Space 키 / 정지 버튼: The Space key / the stop button
탐사선이나 망원경 3,000km 안에서 그 이름표나 \"도킹\" 버튼을: Within 3,000 km of a spacecraft or a telescope, press its label or the "Dock" button: during a count from 3 to 0 you close in, latch on and move with it. Forward, reverse or a slide lets go.
한 번 가 본 곳은 멀리서 그 이름표를 누르거나 수첩에서 \"순간 이동\: A place you have been to once: press its label from far away, or "Jump" in the notebook, and you appear there six seconds later. At a body you appear where it is seen best, at a spacecraft beside it and docked, at a story place above it.
P 키 / 사진 모드 버튼: The P key / the photo mode button
고른 천체나 탐사선, 이야기 장소를 화면 가운데에 두고 가까이에서 봅니다: Puts the chosen body, spacecraft or story place in the middle of the screen and looks at it from close by. Drag to go all the way round it. Something to read shows at the top, and for a body or a spacecraft that is in the notebook there is one question under it. Photos taken here go into the album but do not count for photo missions.
위쪽 맨 오른쪽의 톱니 버튼. 첫 쪽 \"옵션\"에서 화면 비율, 행성: The gear button at the far right of the top. The first page, "Options", changes the language, the screen shape, the planet layout and the sounds. The second page is this help, and the third shows what has changed. How to install the game as an app is there too.
J 키 / 수첩 버튼. 위쪽의 \"가−\", \"가+\"로 글자 크기를: The J key / the notebook button. "A−" and "A+" at the top change the text size in five steps (85% → 150%) for the notebook, the settings and this help together. Finding a new body, touching down on a surface and completing a photo mission are written down. Press the tabs at the top (Bodies, Tasks, Album, Stories, Craft, Tours) to turn the pages (in the album a photo can be saved as a postcard picture, and under the tours is stunt flying for when you feel like it). The ✕ at the top right, Esc, the J key or a press outside the notebook closes it.
태양, 여덟 행성, 위성 21개, 왜행성 둘, 핼리 혜성의 실제 표면 바: You can go right up to the real surfaces of the Sun, the eight planets, 21 moons, two dwarf planets and Halley's Comet. You cannot go inside a body. Only the empty distances between surfaces are cut to 1/100 (1/10 for moons). The default tour layout is not where things really are in the sky today. They are hundreds of times stronger than Earth's, fed also by particles from its moon Io.
엔셀라두스가 지나는 길을 따라 푸르스름한 안개 고리가 있습니다. E 고리:

It is grains of ice from the jets of Enceladus, spread round Saturn. It is clearer with the Sun behind it.
해 가장자리에서 가끔 빛이 번쩍하고 가스 구름이 부풀어 떠납니다. 플레어:
Now and then light flashes at the Sun's edge and a cloud of gas swells and leaves: a flare and a coronal mass ejection.
When such a cloud reaches Earth the auroras grow strong. In 1859 sparks flew from telegraph wires.

Between the bright zones and dark belts, winds of hundreds of km an hour blow opposite ways. The Great Red Spot has rolled between them for over 350 years.

Dark winding lines mark the ground of Mars: the tracks of dust devils.
A whirl sweeps the bright dust away and the dark ground shows. In a few months it is covered again.
천왕성에도 오로라가 있습니다. 밤 쪽에서 보입니다.\n자기장이 자전축에서:
Uranus has auroras too. They show on the night side.
Its magnetic field leans 59 degrees from its spin axis, so they glow far from the poles. Hubble first photographed them in 2011.
천왕성을 두른 가늘고 어두운 고리가 보입니다.\n1977년 별이 천왕성:
You can see the thin dark rings round Uranus.
They were found in 1977 when a star blinked before hiding behind Uranus. Black as charcoal, they send back only 2% of the sunlight.
화성 남극의 얼음 위로 검은 먼지가 뿜어 나옵니다.\n봄 햇살에 드라이아:
Black dust spouts over the ice of Mars's south pole.
In the spring Sun, dry ice turns to gas from below and bursts out. It leaves spider-shaped marks.
금성의 밤 쪽이 어렴풋이 빛납니다. 잿빛 광채입니다.\n1643년부터 보:
The night side of Venus glows faintly: the Ashen Light.
Reports of it go back to 1643, but nobody yet knows the cause.
금성의 밤 쪽 구름 속에서 빛이 번쩍입니다.\n금성의 번개는 아직 논쟁:

Lightning on Venus is still argued over. Spacecraft have caught radio signals, but photographs of the light are rare.

Charged dust is thought to rise above the ground and scatter sunlight. The commander of Apollo 17 sketched it in 1972.
혜성의 푸른 가스 꼬리가 중간에서 끊겨 떨어져 나갑니다.\n태양풍의 자기:

It happens where the magnetic field of the solar wind changes direction. The tail soon grows back.
금성이 해 앞을 지나고 있습니다. 태양면 통과입니다.\n지구에서는 243:

From Earth it can be seen only four times in 243 years. The last was in 2012, the next is in 2117.

Oxygen split by sunlight during the day joins again 95 km up and gives off this light. It is in every photo from the space station.

It is the light of sodium atoms pushed off by sunlight, and it is really millions of km long.
